ContextVerifySql.chat: SELECT c."TenantId" FROM "Conversations" c WHERE c."SubjectType" = split_part(@contextRef, ':', 1) AND c."SubjectId" = CAST(split_part(@contextRef, ':', 2) AS uuid) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "ConversationParticipants" p WHERE p."ConversationId" = c."Id" AND p."ParticipantId" IN (@caller, @target) AND p."IsActive" = true) = 2 LIMIT 1
ContextVerifySql.chat:counterpart: SELECT p."ParticipantId" FROM "ConversationParticipants" p JOIN "Conversations" c ON c."Id" = p."ConversationId" WHERE c."SubjectType" = split_part(@contextRef, ':', 1) AND c."SubjectId" = CAST(split_part(@contextRef, ':', 2) AS uuid) AND p."ParticipantId" <> @caller AND p."IsActive" = true LIMIT 1
